reuse.why: Edits only the existing private getPlannedAmount behind getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; two expressions in the single definition are replaced.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where every server and client consumer already reads it via getScheduledAmount.

scope.why: Touches only the rule, its tests and the related release notes.

maintainability.why: A two-line change to one well-commented function with Math.min expresses the new rule directly.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers keep going through getScheduledAmount.
